meta.scope: Product + pedagogy + HSK1 content + learner model + orchestrator + QA + implementation acceptance tests

product_spec.platform: iOS, initially single-user personal app; architecture extensible for later commercialization

launch_screen.visual: large calligraphic 说 as central tappable element

secondary_actions: Reprendre une séance interrompue if applicable
home.tutor_of_day: avatar + Chinese name; one tutor per session

session_ui.word_card: large hanzi, pinyin, French meaning; elements may hide progressively later
session_ui.model_badge: actual model name continuously visible with complexity color code
session_ui.latency_feedback: short Mandarin transition from a prewritten library (~10 variants); discreet wait sound if useful after user testing

tutors.identity: stable voice + Chinese name + simple recognizable vector avatar

review_mode.selection: fragile + old + recent-to-confirm + structural + occasional strong items

developer_mode.product_learning: journal meaningful setting changes and metrics automatically; no heavy formal A/B test workflow

cost_target.policy: quality wins when uncertain; alerts, not hard cutoff

engine_rules.target_user: single-user personal iOS app initially; architecture should remain extensible if commercialized later
engine_rules.primary_goal: oral conversation; ~90% of learning effort on listening, speaking and pronunciation, with especially strict tones

hsk_policy.principle: HSK progression is the pedagogical spine; Shuō adapts delivery to oral/conversational learning without replacing the HSK scope.
hsk_policy.visual_literacy: hanzi are shown systematically but reading/recognition is not a blocking mastery criterion in the first oral pass

new_items.default: 1–3 new words/expressions maximum per normal session, preferably semantically/structurally related
new_items.five_minute: no new content by default; light review/listening

15_min.content: 1–3 new items with flexible depth + guided/semi-guided/free practice

engine_rules.opening: announce exact items, grammar structure and pronunciation/tone focus before the lesson

word_card.progressive_hiding: possible later; not required for oral mastery

word_template: short nuance/context or francophone trap only when useful

correction.default: let learner finish; correct globally and briefly after the attempt
correction.repeated_error: after 3–4 recurrences, schedule a firmer micro-remediation (~1 min) at start of next session; never let it dominate the next lesson

help_commands.aide: start graded assistance and ask what is blocking; hint → stronger hint → model → solution
help_commands.réponse: skip assistance ladder and give the answer directly, then ask for reuse
help_commands.arrête-toi: pause/exit free conversation and return to guided mode

conversation.safety_net: can regress immediately to guided mode at user request or if difficulty is clearly too high
conversation.French: always available as rescue; progressively reduced as Mandarin competence grows

listening.alternative_activity: short oral dialogue/text up to ~2 minutes followed by comprehension checking, inspired by JLPT-style listening

mastery.pronunciation_requirement: very good to near-perfect; a badly pronounced word cannot be green
mastery.durable_mastery: 5 correct productions total + at least 3 delayed recalls on different sessions (4 preferred if fragile)
mastery.decay: internal memory strength decays over time; green can become fragile and be retested
mastery.downgrade: do not downgrade from one isolated miss; repeated failures across review opportunities can lower status
mastery.review_pool: draws from entire history, not only previous lesson

review_mode.effects: can raise or lower mastery status
review_mode.format: listening + active recall + pronunciation + mini-conversation; not flashcards only

absence_resume.behavior: offer a very short automatic return test; skippable

tutors.identity: distinct stable voice + Chinese name + recognizable vector avatar

voice_ux.switch: visible and easy to change during session
voice_ux.latency: prefer natural voice; use short Mandarin transition phrases during waits; ~10 prewritten variants
voice_ux.model_indicator: show actual active model name continuously with color code; model switches signaled discreetly
voice_ux.offline: pause session if network is lost

ai_architecture.pedagogical_engine: deterministic/structured engine decides curriculum, review, difficulty and session recipe
ai_architecture.LLM: executes conversation/corrections with controlled freedom; models interchangeable
ai_architecture.context: structured learner model + current session + short recent exchange window, not full history every turn
ai_architecture.local_first: progression calculations, review scheduling, scoring and logging local where possible
ai_architecture.routing: lighter model by default; stronger model when needed; quality wins when uncertain

cost.budget: flexible target with alerts, not hard cutoff
cost.optimization: less chatter before fewer pedagogical corrections

product_learning.goal: learn from usage/corrections to improve both personal pedagogy and future product quality
product_learning.experimentation: no heavy formal test/hypothesis workflow; automatically journal meaningful changes and metrics
product_learning.review: brief usefulness signal; periodic check-in every 5 sessions; major adjustments require user confirmation

content: what is solid vs what will return

learner_model.principle: Evidence-based, multi-dimensional, conservative mastery. The LLM never decides mastery alone.

per_item_fields.item_id: stable HSK official key or internal expression id
per_item_fields.error_signatures: bounded array; aggregate patterns, not endless reminders

status_rules.red: new, failed, answer supplied, or pronunciation/tone clearly below threshold
status_rules.orange: understood/usable but fragile, guided, hesitant, or pronunciation not yet strong
status_rules.green: very good pronunciation/tone + spontaneous use + durable delayed recall evidence
status_rules.durable_green: 5 correct productions total and >=3 delayed recalls on different sessions; 4 delayed recalls preferred when fragile
status_rules.downgrade: never from one isolated miss; repeated failures on separated review opportunities can lower memory strength/status

session_orchestrator.new_item_policy: Prefer related words/expressions. If recall is weak, reduce to 1 or 0 new items. Never fill time mechanically.
session_orchestrator.opening: 20–40 s: announce today's words/expressions, structure, pronunciation focus and concrete communicative goal.
per_item_cycle: give nuance/context/francophone trap only if useful (10–30 s)
re-expose later in same session if useful

blocking_logic.aide: ask what is blocking; hint → stronger hint → model → solution
blocking_logic.réponse: give solution immediately, then one reuse attempt
blocking_logic.arrête-toi: pause/free-mode exit and return to guided mode

session_orchestrator.repeated_error: At 3–4 recurrences, flag a firmer micro-remediation (~1 min) for the start of the next session; cap impact so it never hijacks the lesson.
session_orchestrator.conversation: guided → semi-guided → 1–3 min free conversation when appropriate; French rescue always available.
session_orchestrator.end: No new content. 30–60 s factual recap within final block; items + status + one useful pronunciation note + what will return.

ai_routing.principle: Pedagogical engine owns progression; LLM is replaceable execution layer.
ai_routing.context_budget: structured learner summary + current recipe + short recent exchange window; never resend full history by default
ai_routing.fallback: if strong model latency/cost is excessive, lighter model may take over; visible model badge updates
ai_routing.quality_rule: when routing confidence is low, prefer the stronger model

official_course_alignment.copyright_policy: Shuō does not reproduce textbook text/dialogues/exercises. Only public bibliographic structure and lesson themes are used for alignment; all teaching scripts in Shuō are original.
